title: Killer whale
author: National Park Service
changes: Trimmed to 7.50–9.75 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 200 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 1.2 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. The high-pass is set to 200 Hz because the hydrophone recording has strong rumble below 100 Hz; the call itself is above 500 Hz.
